guideImpact.reason: The delivered behaviour introduces a user-visible Display Settings control in a Surveyor layer and a Show linked sites toggle whose state can be changed and restored. Users need instructions for finding Display Settings and understanding or changing this visibility option.

guideUpdate.title: Manage linked-site visibility in a Surveyor layer
steps: Open GIS from the V4 launcher.
Open Display Settings from the layer legend.
View the current state of Show linked sites.
Select Show linked sites to change its state.
Close and reopen Display Settings to confirm the selected state.
guideUpdate.reason: Adds instructions for opening Surveyor Display Settings and changing or confirming the Show linked sites visibility state.
